description.value: This variable needs to be filled with the following params. The name (the variable name), sourceId (id of the resource) and as resource DocumentReference should be filled in

expression.value: iif(Bundle.entry.select(resource as DocumentReference)[0].content[0].attachment.url.startsWith('Binary/'), Bundle.link.where(relation='self').url.replaceMatches('DocumentReference[/?].*$','') + Bundle.entry.select(resource as DocumentReference)[0].content[0].attachment.url, Bundle.entry.select(resource as DocumentReference)[0].content[0].attachment.url)
